name: Compute Cluster S74: Volume Indicators
description: Tests: obv, ad, adosc, emv, kvo, nvi, pvi, vwma, vwap, wad, marketfi, vosc. Comprehensive volume-based indicator coverage.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S74: Volume Indicators
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
open_p = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === ON-BALANCE VOLUME ===
obv_val = obv()(close, volume)

# === ACCUMULATION/DISTRIBUTION ===
ad_val = ad()(high, low, close, volume)

# === AD OSCILLATOR ===
adosc_val = adosc(short_period=3, long_period=10)(high, low, close, volume)

# === EASE OF MOVEMENT ===
emv_val = emv()(high, low, volume)

# === KLINGER VOLUME OSCILLATOR ===
kvo_val = kvo(short_period=34, long_period=55)(high, low, close, volume)

# === NEGATIVE/POSITIVE VOLUME INDEX ===
nvi_val = nvi()(close, volume)
pvi_val = pvi()(close, volume)

# === VOLUME WEIGHTED MOVING AVERAGE ===
vwma_val = vwma(period=20)(close, volume)

# === VOLUME WEIGHTED AVERAGE PRICE (self-contained — fetches own OHLCV) ===
vwap_val = vwap()()

# === WILLIAMS ACCUMULATION/DISTRIBUTION ===
wad_val = wad()(high, low, close)

# === MARKET FACILITATION INDEX ===
mfi_val = marketfi()(high, low, volume)

# === VOLUME OSCILLATOR ===
vosc_val = vosc(short_period=5, long_period=20)(volume)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='OBV & A/D Line',
    category='Volume',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OBV', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='A/D', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(obv_val, ad_val))

xy_lines(
    title='AD Oscillator & KVO',
    category='Volume Oscillators',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ADOSC(3,10)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='KVO(34,55)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(adosc_val, kvo_val))

xy_lines(
    title='NVI / PVI',
    category='Volume Index',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVI', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PVI', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(nvi_val, pvi_val))

xy_lines(
    title='VWMA / VWAP vs Close',
    category='Volume Weighted',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VWMA(20)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VWAP', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, vwma_val, vwap_val))

xy_lines(
    title='Market Facilitation / Volume Osc',
    category='Volume',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MarketFI', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VOSC(5,20)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(mfi_val, vosc_val))
